experiment: IFA bonus -> expected-WAR pedigree curve (P1 companion)

protocol.pre_registered: 2026-07-23, in the tools/ifa_pedigree_lab.py header BEFORE fitting; seed 20260723
protocol.cohort: Spotrac IFA tracker classes 2012-2017 (row-year), bonus_usd > 0, deduped earliest-class-first
protocol.outcome: summed bWAR (war_daily bat+pitch, platform basis) over calendar seasons sign+2..sign+8; never-MLB = 0 (real); window end <= 2025 so 2017 is the last class
protocol.window_choice: calendar-anchored (not debut-anchored) so busts are real zeros; IFA sign at 16-17, debut +4..+7, so +2..+8 spans the plausible early-MLB years
protocol.curve: 7 pre-registered bonus tiers (50k/100k/250k/500k/1M/2M/inf), per-tier weighted mean -> increasing weighted PAVA (mirror of the draft slot curve fit)
protocol.gate: leave-one-class-out by signing year; pooled held-out Spearman > 0 AND bootstrap lo95 > 0 (10k resamples); raw log10(bonus) pooled rho reported as the bins-add-nothing null

why_not_the_db_cohort.note: bonus coverage is the 2021+ Spotrac scrape window; resolvable outcomes are pre-2018 classes; the intersection cannot support a binned fit, hence the direct Spotrac 2012-2017 cohort

caveats: Spotrac lists only part of each class (skewed to larger bonuses); the curve is E[WAR | bonus, tracker-listed]. The unlisted mass is small-bonus and near-uniformly 0 WAR, so tail tiers read optimistic if extrapolated to unlisted signees.
Signing age is not observed; older (mostly Cuban) signees share tiers with 16-17 amateurs. Cuba split reported in sensitivity.
Name-based outcome matching can miss (false zeros); bounded by the career_war rescue + QA pass for tracked players.

first6 basis is right-censored for late debuts of the 2016-17 classes (a 2017 signee debuting 2023 shows 3 of 6 seasons); the 2012-2014-only refit is the censoring check. Conservative-at-top is the safe direction for a prior.
Every outcome window contains COVID-2020 (no 2020 MiLB season, shortened MLB season).
Hard-cap bonus pools arrived July 2017; the 2017 fold doubles as the era-shift sensitivity. 2018+ classes resolve from 2027 on; refit then.

Posted NPB/KBO professionals signed under the bonus pool sit in the cohort (Ohtani 2017 is the single largest outcome); the posted-pro-excluded sensitivity removes Japan/South Korea/Taiwan rows. They are not amateur pedigree.
finding: Gate verdict: FAIL (pooled LOO rho positive but bootstrap lo95 crosses 0).

Raw log-bonus is NOT a ranker of IFA outcomes on these classes (pooled rho -0.023): below $1M the realized tier means are flat-to-inverted (the $10-50k tier OUTPERFORMS the $100-250k tier: Acuna $100k, Kirk $30k, Rafaela $10k, Framber $10k...). The isotonic bins beat raw by pooling that non-monotone middle flat.

The one robust structure is the >= $1M step: mean window WAR 1.7 (n=142) vs 0.18 (n=1387) below, diff CI95 excludes 0. A future arm could price an IFA prior for >= $1M bonuses ONLY, but that is a NEW experiment and needs its own pre-registration, not a post-hoc rescue of this one.
All 6 per-class held-out rhos are individually positive (0.05-0.12), consistent with a weak real signal that the pre-registered pooled bootstrap correctly refuses to certify.
Consequence for P1: the efv_score IFA branch KEEPS its consensus-only behavior ('no WAR from a bonus alone' stands, now with evidence). No curve artifact, no integration diff emitted.
